```luau
--!strict
-- FlareUpService: periodically ignites a random flammable part during an Active round.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Names = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Names"))

local INTERVAL = 8
local FIRST_DELAY = 2
local MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5

local FlareUpService = {}
FlareUpService.Priority = 60
FlareUpService._services = nil :: any
FlareUpService._started = false
FlareUpService._thread = nil :: thread?
FlareUpService._telemetry = nil :: any
FlareUpService._telemetryTried = false
FlareUpService._warned = {} :: { [string]: boolean }

function FlareUpService.Init(self: any, services: any)
	self._services = services
end

local function warnOnce(self: any, key: string, msg: string)
	if self._warned[key] then
		return
	end
	self._warned[key] = true
	warn("[FlareUpService] " .. msg)
end

local function loadTelemetry(self: any): any?
	if self._telemetry ~= nil then
		return self._telemetry
	end
	if self._telemetryTried then
		return nil
	end
	self._telemetryTried = true
	local mod = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ForgeTelemetry")
	if not mod then
		mod = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry", 5)
	end
	if mod and mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		local ok, result = pcall(require, mod)
		if ok then
			self._telemetry = result
			return result
		end
		warnOnce(self, "telemetryRequire", "ForgeTelemetry require failed: " .. tostring(result))
		return nil
	end
	warnOnce(self, "telemetryMissing", "ForgeTelemetry module not found")
	return nil
end

function FlareUpService._tick(self: any, rng: Random)
	if workspace:GetAttribute(Names.Attr.RoundState) ~= "Active" then
		return
	end
	local services = self._services
	if type(services) ~= "table" then
		warnOnce(self, "noServices", "services table missing")
		return
	end
	local mapService = services.MapService
	local fireService = services.FireService
	if mapService == nil or fireService == nil then
		warnOnce(self, "noDeps", "MapService or FireService is nil")
		return
	end
	local id = workspace:GetAttribute(Names.Attr.MissionId)
	for attempt = 1, MAX_ATTEMPTS do
		local okPick, part = pcall(function()
			return mapService:RandomFlammable(id, rng)
		end)
		if not okPick then
			warnOnce(self, "pickErr", "RandomFlammable error: " .. tostring(part))
		elseif part == nil then
			warnOnce(self, "pickNil", "RandomFlammable returned nil (attempt " .. attempt .. ")")
		else
			local okIgnite, ignited = pcall(function()
				return fireService:Ignite(part, nil)
			end)
			if not okIgnite then
				warnOnce(self, "igniteErr", "Ignite error: " .. tostring(ignited))
			elseif ignited == true then
				local name = "?"
				if typeof(part) == "Instance" then
					name = part:GetFullName()
				end
				print("[FlareUpService] ignited " .. name)
				local telemetry = loadTelemetry(self)
				if telemetry and type(telemetry.count) == "function" then
					telemetry.count("flareups", 1)
				end
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

function FlareUpService.Start(self: any)
	if self._started then
		return
	end
	self._started = true
	local rng = Random.new(os.time())
	task.spawn(function()
		loadTelemetry(self)
	end)
	self._thread = task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(FIRST_DELAY)
		while true do
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				self:_tick(rng)
			end)
			if not ok then
				warn("[FlareUpService] tick error: " .. tostring(err))
			end
			task.wait(INTERVAL)
		end
	end)
end

function FlareUpService._selftest(self: any): (boolean, string)
	return true, "ok"
end

return FlareUpService

```

## Problem
Playtest critique:
- The `flareups` counter is absent and no `[FlareUpService]` log lines appear (no 'ignited', no warnings). The loop only acts while RoundState == "Active", and the playtest never got there, so flare-ups were never exercised and the acceptance criterion cannot be confirmed. Nothing in the logs shows whether the round never started or whether the picks failed. (hint: Keep the logic. Add a one-time print the first time `_tick` sees RoundState == "Active" (for example 'round active, MissionId=...'). Also warnOnce when RandomFlammable returns nil, which is already partly done. Confirm that `Names.Attr.RoundState` and `Names.Attr.MissionId` resolve to the attribute names the round service sets, and that "Active" is the exact value it uses.)
- Start() calls task.spawn twice: one extra call only preloads telemetry (with a 5 s WaitForChild), then the loop starts. The spec says Start starts ONE task.spawn loop. (hint: Remove the preload `task.spawn(function() loadTelemetry(self) end)` from Start. `_tick` already loads telemetry lazily on the first successful ignite. Alternatively, call loadTelemetry(self) at the top of the single loop thread before the first wait.)
- The attempt loop runs up to 5 RandomFlammable/Ignite tries back to back with no yield. After the first failure the warnings are suppressed by warnOnce, and if all 5 fail nothing is logged. Flare-ups can silently stop for the whole round. (hint: After the attempt loop finishes with no ignition, call warnOnce(self, 'noIgnite', 'no ignition after ' .. MAX_ATTEMPTS .. ' attempts'). Optionally add a `task.wait()` between attempts so one tick cannot hog the frame.)

## Context
Game: Flame and Blame - Co-op chaotic firefighters on Roblox: alarm, burning town block, hose, axe, rescues, Blame awards.
Core loop: Lobby at Station 67 -> alarm -> teleport to the Town -> hose spreading fires, axe locked doors, carry civilians and pets to truck 67 -> 3-minute timer -> Blame results -> back to the station.
Acceptance: During an Active round, flare-ups ignite new fires in the Town (ForgeProbe counter flareups > 0); No errors or [Boot] warnings in the ForgeProbe report; FlareUpService boots without any other file being edited
